Ocean-View Dining

Curry, Wok & Waves

A Symphony of Flavours by the Sea

At Koko Maya Resort, dining is more than just a meal — it's an experience. Our restaurant, "Curry, Wok & Waves," offers a curated menu that celebrates the rich culinary heritage of Goa alongside classic Indian and Chinese favorites.

40 Seats

Where Taste Meets the Horizon

Located on our first floor, the open-air design ensures you never lose touch with the sea breeze. Whether you're enjoying our breakfast buffet or a candle-lit à la carte dinner, the view of Morjim Beach provides the perfect backdrop.

  • Open-Air Seating: Enjoy the sea breeze and the sound of waves as you dine.
  • Local Ingredients: We source fresh seafood and produce from Morjim markets daily.
  • Beach Views: Located on the first floor with sweeping views of the Arabian Sea.
  • Private Dining: Perfect for romantic dinners or intimate family celebrations.

Planning a Special Event?

From birthdays to team lunches, Curry, Wok & Waves is the ideal venue for small gatherings. Contact our team to discuss customized menus and private arrangements.
